title: Razlo's Deal

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Your Automata. She’s unusual.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Calm down, I performed a few non-invasive scans, that's all. Would I be right in thinking she has access to the Old Network?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Calm down, I performed a few non-invasive scans, that's all. Would I be right in thinking she has access to the Old Network?

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: I need the ID code for a particular server there. If your Ava can get it for me, then I'll give you the photos.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I need the ID code for a particular server there. If your Ava can get it for me, then I'll give you the photos.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Just some files of academic interest.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Just some files of academic interest.
Hybris1.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: I’ve made my offer. I suggest you take it. The server is called Hybris1.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I’ve made my offer. I suggest you take it. The server is called Hybris1.
I do.
I don't.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: It seems to be full of long academic papers on data sub-layers… but it's possible they are a smokescreen for something else.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: It seems to be full of long academic papers on data sub-layers… but it's possible they are a smokescreen for something else.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: No. There is so much data there… without knowing what I was looking for, it might take months. Even years.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: No. There is so much data there… without knowing what I was looking for, it might take months. Even years.

nodes.speaker: Ava
nodes.text: Yes... I have it. Shall I transmit it to Razlo?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes... I have it. Shall I transmit it to Razlo?
Well?

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: So, you're back. Took you longer than I thought. Are you always so slow?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: So, you're back. Took you longer than I thought. Are you always so slow?

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Now now, that's no way to do business.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Now now, that's no way to do business.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: I told you before. They come at a cost.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I told you before. They come at a cost.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Then it seems Mr Nyx-Curzona belongs to me. We're going to be such good friends over the years. I can tell.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Then it seems Mr Nyx-Curzona belongs to me. We're going to be such good friends over the years. I can tell.

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Oh, this is too good. You have no idea what you've given me, do you? And all for a few silly photos.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Oh, this is too good. You have no idea what you've given me, do you? And all for a few silly photos.
I have shiploads of money!

nodes.speaker: Razlo
nodes.text: Take them, and thank Eldridge for me. I simply couldn't have done this without him.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Take them, and thank Eldridge for me. I simply couldn't have done this without him.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Give me the photos of Eldridge.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Give me the photos of Eldridge.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Give me the photos of Eldridge.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Give me the photos of Eldridge.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Stay away from Ava!
How do you know?
So what if she did?
What's on the server?
Fine. Server name?
For what purpose?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: Ava, do you know what he’s talking about?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Ava, do you know what he’s talking about?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: Ava, do you know what he’s talking about?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: Ava, do you know what he’s talking about?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Do you trust him?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: OK, can you get the code?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: OK, can you get the code?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: OK, can you get the code?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: OK, can you get the code?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: What's on the server?
Can you tell what?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: But you can get the code?

pronounText.TextHeVersion: But you can get the code?
pronounText.TextSheVersion: But you can get the code?
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: But you can get the code?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: I changed my mind. I'm not giving you anything.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: I changed my mind. I'm not giving you anything.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: I changed my mind. I'm not giving you anything.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: I changed my mind. I'm not giving you anything.

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: She’s sending it to you now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: She’s sending it to you now.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: She’s sending it to you now.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: She’s sending it to you now.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Are you always so obnoxious?
What do you want?

nodes.speaker: Player
nodes.text: How much? I'm sure Eldridge will pay.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: How much? I'm sure Eldridge will pay.
pronounText.TextSheVersion: How much? I'm sure Eldridge will pay.
pronounText.TextTheyVersion: How much? I'm sure Eldridge will pay.

pronounText.TextHeVersion: Yes.
